Robert Sterling
Engineering Manager
San Francisco, CA | robert.sterling@email.com | +1 555-011-2299 | linkedin.com/in/rsterling-eng

EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
Engineering Manager with 12 years of experience building high-performing software engineering teams, driving technical strategy, and delivering cloud infrastructure projects. Proven leader of 18+ engineers across backend, frontend, and DevOps disciplines. Reduced deployment time by 42% and increased release frequency by 60%.

WORK EXPERIENCE
Engineering Manager | CloudScale Enterprise | San Francisco, CA | 2020 - Present
- Led a team of 18 engineers across 3 pod teams, managing hiring, mentoring, career development, and performance reviews.
- Reduced deployment time by 42% and improved release frequency by 60% by driving transition to CI/CD and microservices architecture.
- Managed $4M annual cloud infrastructure budget on AWS, optimizing resource allocation to achieve a 30% cost reduction.
- Architected high-availability distributed systems serving 50M+ requests per day with 99.99% operational uptime.
- Mentored 12+ developers into senior engineering and tech lead roles.

Software Engineering Lead | Nexus Global Systems | San Francisco, CA | 2015 - 2020
- Scaled engineering department from 5 to 25 developers, driving talent acquisition and tech recruitment.
- Oversaw technical delivery of enterprise cloud migration project, completing migration 2 months ahead of schedule.
- Established technical standards for Code Review, TDD, Architecture Reviews, and Incident Retrospectives.

Senior Software Engineer | DataCorp Solutions | San Jose, CA | 2012 - 2015
- Built distributed microservices in Java, Go, Python, and PostgreSQL.

EDUCATION
Master of Science in Computer Science | Stanford University | 2010 - 2012
Bachelor of Science in Computer Engineering | UC Davis | 2006 - 2010

TECHNICAL LEADERSHIP & SKILLS
- Management & Leadership: Team Leadership, Hiring, Mentoring, Engineering Metrics, Technical Strategy, Agile Delivery, Budgeting
- Technical Expertise: Architecture, Cloud Infrastructure, AWS, Microservices, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, Java, Python, PostgreSQL, DevOps
jobDescriptionText: Seeking an Engineering Manager with 10+ years experience to lead a team of 15+ engineers. Responsibilities: hiring, mentoring, architecture, delivery, engineering metrics, cloud infrastructure, and technical strategy. Must demonstrate quantified leadership achievements.
